title: In Swing — EN/JA/ZH (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The in-swinger comes at you from outside off
And then it doesn't
It changes its mind mid-flight
Or rather it never had your mind in mind at all — you had its

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
縫い目が秘密だ [The seam is the secret]
リリースの瞬間の手首の角度 [The angle of the wrist at the moment of release]
一度の差が [One degree is the difference]
意図した場所に行くことと [Between going where you meant]
常に向かっていた場所に行くことの差だ [And going where it was always going]

[Chorus — English]
In swing says — you think you know where this is going
In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip
In swing says — that's already too much thinking
In swing says — you've already missed

[Bridge — 中文]
内摆说 — 你以为你知道这要去哪里 [In swing says — you think you know where this is going]
内摆说 — 看缝合线，看握法 [In swing says — look at the seam, look at the grip]
内摆说 — 那已经是太多思考了 [In swing says — that's already too much thinking]
内摆说 — 你已经错过了 [In swing says — you've already missed]

[Verse 3 — English]
The in-swinger is not deceptive — it's honest
It goes exactly where physics says it will

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
In swing
インスウィング [In swing]
内摆 [In swing]
That's my boy
